page.overview:
Who is Patty?

"As the personal assistant to one of the world's most famous race cars, Patty knows that whether on the track or on the highway, Mario is always racing. She doesn't bother keeping up with him because inevitably she'll find him on the side of the road talking with local police - only he's not getting a ticket, he's signing autographs."
